name: Sleep Cycle Bedtime Calculator

seo.title: Sleep Cycle Bedtime Calculator | AafnaiPatro
seo.description: Plan an adult bedtime around realistic total sleep duration, without treating 90-minute cycles as fixed.

inputs.label: Time normally taken to fall asleep

explanation: Work backward from wake time by 7, 8, or 9 hours of sleep plus individual sleep-onset latency; clock calculations wrap across midnight.
limitations: No fixed 90-minute cycle guarantees an optimal wake time; adult needs differ; shift workers should seek tailored advice.
